def build_mine(res, n=2):
    p = nearest(res)
    bb = BuildingBox(width=3*n, height=3+3+1)
    area = nearest_buildable(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, bb, p)
    lt = area.left_top
    move_to(lt)
    outs = []
    for i in range(n):
        dp = Position(x=lt.x + 1.5 + 3*i, y=lt.y + 1.5)
        drill = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=dp, direction=Direction.DOWN)
        fur = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, reference_position=drill.position, direction=Direction.DOWN)
        ins = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.Inserter, reference_position=fur.position, direction=Direction.DOWN)
        print(res[0], 'drill', drill.position, 'drop', drill.drop_position, 'fur', fur.position, 'ins', ins.position, ins.direction, 'ins drop', ins.drop_position)
        outs.append((drill, fur, ins))
    return outs

def build_at(xs, y):

        drill = get_entities({Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill}, position=dp, radius=0.6)

        fur = get_entities({Prototype.ElectricFurnace}, position=fp, radius=0.6)
        fur = fur[0] if fur else place_entity(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, position=fp)
        ip = Position(x=x, y=y+5)
